title: Kodera2023
description: A left/right-hand motor imagery EEG dataset recorded at the University of West Bohemia from 29 healthy participants. Cue-based single-class imagery trials of 4 s were recorded in 4 runs per session using BrainVision hardware. The data are provided in BIDS format with HED event annotations and are intended for brain-computer interface research and benchmarking via MOABB.
methods_description: EEG was recorded with BrainVision Recorder (BrainProducts) at 500 Hz from 9 channels (Fz, Cz, Pz, F3, F4, P3, P4, C3, C4) placed according to the standard 10-20 montage. Participants performed cue-based left- or right-hand motor imagery, with each recording containing a single class and the cue onset marked by a stimulus marker. Each session comprised 4 runs with a 4 s trial interval, and the line frequency was 50 Hz.
